row_status_semantics.PASS_SCHEMA_ONLY: All required fields are present and internally typed. This permits curation of the row shape only; it does not permit fixture execution, validation, recovery, safety, or closure claims.
row_status_semantics.HOLD_PENDING_EXACT_ROW: A required field is missing, ambiguous, context-only, advisory-only, unresolved, or awaiting source/fixture binding.
row_status_semantics.FAIL_CONTRADICTION: Two rows conflict, a row promotes a demoted item, or a row's stated support exceeds its source authority.
row_status_semantics.BLOCKED_OVERCLAIM: A row implies validation, final physics, solved consciousness, empirical spiritual proof, fifth-force safety, or canon promotion.

lint_rules.name: required_provenance_triplet
lint_rules.condition: Any row lacks provenance_entity_id, provenance_activity_id, or provenance_agent_id.

lint_rules.name: provenance_not_truth
lint_rules.condition: A row treats provenance fields as validation, identity proof, source truth, or authority.

lint_rules.name: measurement_requires_measurand
lint_rules.condition: measurement_technique is not not_measurement or not_applicable, but measurand_or_quantity is blank or undefined.

lint_rules.name: uncertainty_required_for_constraints
lint_rules.condition: An external constraint, fixture, or proxy row lacks uncertainty_model.

lint_rules.name: null_result_not_absence_or_safety
lint_rules.condition: A null result or future null fixture is described as absence, recovery, validation, safety, or gate closure.

lint_rules.name: metric_action_boundary_required
lint_rules.condition: Metric/action or scalar-route rows lack metric_action_boundary_policy.

lint_rules.name: metric_action_no_derivation_without_artifact
lint_rules.condition: A convention row claims scalar EOM, T_Psi_mu_nu, conservation, or null recovery without exact derivation artifact.

lint_rules.name: B_Psi_remains_demoted
lint_rules.condition: B_Psi is used as active coefficient, tensor, field, source, or fixture input before a separate definition artifact exists.

lint_rules.name: external_parameterization_required
lint_rules.condition: Fifth-force/equivalence row lacks candidate parameter, observable target, bound form, unit, regime, source role, or assumption basis.

lint_rules.name: external_constraints_not_safety
lint_rules.condition: External-constraint routing is described as fifth-force safety or equivalence-principle compatibility.

lint_rules.name: proxy_false_positive_routes_required
lint_rules.condition: Consciousness, meaning, or dignity proxy rows omit proxy_false_positive_routes.

lint_rules.name: proxy_not_consciousness_proof
lint_rules.condition: Proxy metadata is described as consciousness measurement success, identity proof, or empirical spiritual proof.

lint_rules.name: journey_context_boundary
lint_rules.condition: Journey or Solas material appears without journey_context_not_canon classification and local path/line reference.

lint_rules.name: support_collision_conflict_key
lint_rules.condition: Rows with the same measurement_technique, measurand_or_quantity, external_constraint_parameterization, and provenance_entity_id conflict on support role.

claim_ceiling: Schema hardening only; no gate progress.
